QAMÉ

Profile

From customer insight to product

My work in UK retail and UAE transport taught me to look for what customers need and where a process breaks down. At ATW Studio, I use those observations to shape product ideas, build working demos and develop the story around them.

Marketing and brand development

I explore audience research, positioning and visual storytelling through independent case studies and concepts like the Emirati™ collection.

Product development

I build hands-on prototypes for fleet coordination, payment verification and customer analytics. Each demo gives people a way to try the idea and suggest what to build next.
